papers.title: Immersive Virtual Reality Exergaming vs Video-Guided Screen-Based Exercise for Cognitive and Neurophysiological Adaptations in Young Adults: Protocol for Acute and Chronic Experimental Studies.
papers.reason: This protocol directly targets inhibitory control with Stroop performance and frontal theta EEG, but it is an intervention design with no results yet.

papers.title: Dynamic Brain Network Transitions and Sensorimotor Performance Across the Adult Lifespan.
papers.reason: The title suggests human brain network dynamics and lifespan performance, but the focus appears to be sensorimotor performance rather than executive function, planning, working memory, or attention.

papers.title: Prefrontal transcranial direct current stimulation combined with cognitive training reduces anxiety, daytime sleepiness, and cognitive complaints in women after COVID-19: A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial.
papers.reason: This human trial links left prefrontal stimulation and cognitive training to cognitive outcomes and prefrontal EEG markers, though executive function modelling is not central.

papers.title: Under-recognized Autoimmune Encephalitis in Patients with Alzheimer's Disease: A Case Series Emphasizing EEG Screening.
papers.reason: This appears relevant to clinical cognitive screening with EEG in Alzheimer's disease but has no clear focus on executive function, computational modelling, or task-based assessment.
